scientific_integrity: The sharp class-L / Lévy-driven OU stationary-marginal classification is proved analytically using a pre-existing stationary Fourier transform and the classical self-decomposability criterion; the Fourier transform itself is not new. Equal diffusivity, strictly positive switching/relaxation parameters, and one-time stationary marginal only. Mathematical priority beyond inspected related texts remains unverified independently.
scientific_limitations: No equivalence of entire trajectories or multi-time statistics.
No extension to nonharmonic confinement or switching-dependent diffusivity.
The exact Fourier transform was previously obtained by Zhang and Wang (2017); only the self-decomposability phase classification is proposed as new.
Formal independent assessment of originality and mathematical details has not been performed.
title: A sharp class-L transition for a two-rate intermittently confined Brownian particle
